The patient was able to feed by bottle without difficulty. Esophageal motility appeared within normal limits. Gastric motility and morphology appeared within normal limits. The duodenal bulb was well distended and has a normal morphology. The position of the ligament of Treitz appears normal with no evidence for malrotation seen. The visualized portion of the proximal small bowel to the level of the proximal jejunum appears unremarkable. During 5 minutes of intermittent fluoroscopic evaluation, one episode of gastroesophageal reflux to the thoracic esophagus was noted. This cleared rapidly. No further episodes of reflux were identified.
Impression: One episode of high gastroesophageal reflux with rapid clearing was seen but this would not be considered significant fluoroscopically (3 or greater episodes in 5 minutes). Otherwise normal UGI.
